records.query: How do I register / create an account?
records.answer: To create a new account: 1) Tap 'Create New Account'. 2) Add your phone number. 3) You'll receive a verification code via SMS. 4) Enter the code in the app to complete registration. Then complete your data through 'My Account', click the settings icon, and select 'Edit profile'. You now have an account and can enjoy all available offers.

records.query: How do I purchase from the Waffarha app?
records.answer: 1) Choose the offer that suits you. 2) Select the number of coupons and click 'Add to Cart'. 3) Click 'Go to Cart' to review your order details. 4) Click 'Proceed to Checkout' and choose your preferred payment method. 5) After completing payment, find your coupon number under 'My Orders' > 'Order Details' > 'Show Offer Code'. You can use the coupon at the location or request delivery if available for that offer and your area is within the delivery zone; an additional delivery fee set by the merchant may apply.

records.query: Can I pay my electricity bill through the app?
records.answer: Go to the 'Bill Payment' section in the app. You'll see services like balance recharge, mobile & landline bills, utility bills, and monthly installments. Select the service, enter the number you want to top-up or pay for, click 'Proceed to Payment', then choose the payment method that suits you.

records.query: What payment methods can I use to pay bills?
records.answer: Bank cards (Visa/MasterCard), Bank Installments, E-wallets (Vodafone Cash, Etisalat Cash, Orange Cash, and others), TRU, Suhoola, Forsa, Premium Card, and Contact Installments. Note: available payment methods for bills may change, so check the checkout page for the current options.

records.query: How do I check if my bill payment went through?
records.answer: Click on 'Profile', select 'Payments', then select the bill you want to know the status of — full details will be shown.

records.query: How do I get a refund for a coupon I bought?
records.answer: Open 'My Orders', select the coupon you want to refund, click 'Refund Coupon', then choose the refund method that suits you from the available options. Note: refunds are available anytime before the offer's expiration date, which you can find under 'My Account'.

records.query: How do I remove a saved bank card from my account?
records.answer: Make sure the app is updated to the latest version. While purchasing, use the same bank card and activate the 'Save Card' option before completing payment. Next time you pay with the same saved card, you'll only need to enter the CVV and the OTP sent by your bank via SMS — no need to re-enter card details. You can add multiple cards the same way.

records.query: How do I buy a gift voucher for a friend?
records.answer: 1) Select the gift voucher from the available list of brands. 2) Confirm the amount and value of vouchers you want to purchase. 3) Select whether you'll use it yourself or send it as a gift. 4) Complete the purchase with your preferred payment method and confirm the order. 5) Go to the 'Gift Vouchers' section to review your voucher's details.

records.query: How does the cashback policy work?
records.answer: Cashback balance is valid for 30 days from the time it's added. It's added after a coupon is activated with the merchant (or after a bill payment). You can use either cashback OR a discount code, not both on the same order. Track your cashback (time added, expiry date) under 'My Wallet' inside 'My Account'. Cashback can only be used to purchase coupons — it cannot be used for bill payments and is not redeemable as cash.

records.query: What information does Waffarha collect about me?
records.answer: Waffarha collects Personally Identifiable Information (PII) such as name, address, email, phone, date of birth, and payment details when you create an account, order products, post reviews, enter contests, or sign up for offers — used to deliver services, personalize the app, and communicate with you. It also collects Non-PII (browser type, IP address, referring URLs) automatically via cookies and similar technologies, used to operate and analyze the platform. Waffarha may update this policy at any time; material changes are communicated via email or a notice on the platform.

records.query: Is Waffarha better than Groupon?
records.answer: Waffarha negotiates discounted, ready-to-use offers on your behalf with stores and service providers, using group buying: when enough people are interested in an offer, Waffarha negotiates as a single large buyer, letting the seller offer a much bigger discount than they could to an individual. This benefits customers (real discounts, new services to try), sellers (reach new customers, sell more volume), and Waffarha (connects both sides). The offers on Waffarha are not available directly from the seller at the same price.
